title: Deeper/broader cross-project parser, writer, and consumer-route readiness review
mode: primary-source web research and local plan/source/test cross-check
scope: Reconcile current open-source parser-safety, writer-integrity, and consumer-backend evidence
Check existing repeated-record readiness against local source and generated tests
Refine implementation-ready validation without increasing per-slice test or peer-runtime cost
Keep platform and independent semantic qualification separate from local implementation

method.validationStatus: This pass reran the focused repeated-record selector and owning libdxfrw_hardening CTest; both passed. No full suite was run.
method.limitations: Peer issue reports and mutable documentation are discovery/route evidence, not normative DXF/DWG rules or proof of matching libdxfrw defects. ACadSharp #1282/#1283 were visible only as issue-index titles in this pass. No peer package or application behavior was independently reproduced.

sources.observed: The report details recursive advancement for repeated comments, XDATA application blocks, and IMAGE/WIPEOUT clip-boundary records, with process termination as the reported failure. Its exact version and stress counts are peer-specific, not format maxima.
Titles #1282 and #1283 describe per-application EED size loss and nested-block copy complexity. Their issue bodies were not retrieved; they remain title-only leads.

The reporter describes a DXF string quoting path whose output was not terminated at the last written byte before strlen(), allowing allocator residue to enter text; a latent empty-after-quoting path could omit a group. The issue links peer commits, but this pass did not build or verify a released artifact.

The report describes malformed R2004+ DWG timestamp fields causing MSVC/UCRT fail-fast through strftime() when tm_mday is zero. The issue is specific to the reported LibreDWG revision/platform and does not establish a local libdxfrw call-chain match.

The documented C++ and legacy Python DXF importer matrices differ: 3DFACE and LEADER are listed only for the legacy importer, and the C++ block route omits text, dimensions, and attributes inside blocks. The doc says both routes support DXF starting at R12 and stock FreeCAD does not read ACIS solids.
The project describes a native DXF importer plus external-converter DWG path. This supports backend/converter pinning but is not a run of a specific application build.

sources.project: ezdxf ordinary read and audit/recovery documentation
sources.observed: The docs direct structurally flawed input to the separate recovery module; launcher docs expose audit-and-save. A recovered result is not the same strict parse result.
The library documents callback delivery for supported entities and states that it does not retain entities or other drawing information.
The driver documents geometry projection separately from the AC1027+ opt-in raw ASM byte and affine-transform route; default solid entities are skipped when they cannot become OGR geometry.

The manual distinguishes stable, unstable, debugging, and unhandled classes and documents route/version-specific writer limitations; separate HACKING/NEWS pages record fuzz routes and peer security fixes.

localCrossCheck.repeatedRecordSlice: The current hardening source contains 20,000 post-SECTION ASCII comments, 20,000 ordered group-1001/group-1000 XDATA pairs in ASCII/Binary, and restarted WIPEOUT group-91 stress inputs in ASCII/Binary, with following-LINE, callback, and same-reader retry assertions.
localCrossCheck.readerShape: Local comment skipping and entity XDATA parsing use iterative loops; IMAGE/WIPEOUT clip input has count bounds and iterative vertex state. No matching recursive-per-item local defect was found in inspected paths.
localCrossCheck.testStatus: Focused selector and owning hardening CTest were previously reported passing; not rerun as part of research.
localCrossCheck.outputAndPlatform: The peer's C allocator and UCRT failure modes are not directly transferable to the local C++ writer/reader. Keep exact output framing checks and Windows process-failure qualification conditional on a touched matching path.

assessment.peerEvidenceRule: A peer issue identifies a failure shape only for its cited revision, artifact, route, and platform. It does not define format maxima or create a libdxfrw defect without local source mapping and reproduction.
assessment.freecadRule: Pin importer backend, build/platform, preferences and converter; keep common 2D compatibility distinct from backend-specific entity coverage and ACIS semantics.
assessment.speedRule: Use the focused strict target/selector and owning CTest for a touched leaf; keep peer tools, native applications, full suites, and fuzz/sanitizer runs at the scheduled composed checkpoint.
